schema_version: 1
integrations:
  - service: ms-go-learning-planner
    transport: HTTP
    direction: consumed by ms-go-student
    endpoints:
      assignment: PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/courses/{courseID}/assignment
      learning_path: PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-path
      learning_path_completion: PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-path/completion
      learning_path_planning_state: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/planning-state
      learning_path_replan: PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}
      learning_path_exact_completion: PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/completion
    auth: dedicated LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN
    idempotency: assignment uses UUID Idempotency-Key plus unique planning_request_id; a new-path command may use the same pair and Student returns the one transactionally allocated path ID on replay
    ownership: Planner may assign an ordinary Course and submit path content; Student owns path identity, persistence, selected context, lifecycle, progress, and mastery
    exact_path_reconciliation: Planner supplies desired Course identity plus PLANNED/READY items; Student atomically replaces only the addressed path and preserves advanced progress status/reason/frozen targets only for exact matching references, never target overlap alone
    exact_path_replay: Student stores the full bounded command response atomically; exact replay is version-stable and conflicting identity/hash reuse returns 409
    diagnostic_reservation: POST /internal/v1/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessments/{planID}/reserve accepts only exact Planner diagnostic-assessment-plan.v1 under LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN, with Idempotency-Key exactly equal to planID; GET /internal/v1/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/result returns only an immutable completed safe aggregate; general token is rejected
    diagnostic_replay: reservation and submission receipt replay is validated by Student before any Course diagnostic-catalog or trusted task-definition read; Course catalog uses distinct COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_TOKEN while Student's owner/frozen-task-gated diagnostic port reads trusted task metadata without public/assignment gating, and diagnostics remain placement-only with no mastery/path side effects; completion writes only the reference trigger for automatic Planner placement
  - service: ms-go-learning-planner
    direction: produced by ms-go-student
    transport: JetStream
    stream: STUDENT_DIAGNOSTIC_EVENTS
    subject: student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1
    contract: schema version 1 existing envelope, reference-only plan_id/plan_revision/plan_digest/result_digest
    identity: stable UUID SHA1 URL namespace over exact subject + colon + plan ID; correlation is plan ID equals attempt ID; causation is completion request UUID; occurred_at is immutable result completed_at
    ownership: Student commits result/receipt/outbox atomically; Planner validates its frozen plan and the dedicated Student result read before existing fixed placement; initial planning/path allocation requires separate explicit learner intent
    recovery: publisher uses existing acknowledged outbox relay with stable delivery headers; exact completion replay adds no event; browser/Teacher recovery remains compatible; no historical backfill
  - service: ms-go-learning-planner
    transport: HTTP
    direction: consumed by ms-go-learning-planner
    endpoint: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/planning-readiness
    auth: X-Internal-Token shared secret
    contract: student-planning-readiness-snapshot.v1; bounded read-only Student onboarding/current selected-path projection
    ownership: Student chooses accepted draft over finalized profile and supplies only exact accepted onboarding facts; Planner owns all graph, gap, and route decisions
  - service: ms-go-teacher-agent
    transport: JetStream
    stream: TEACHER_EVENTS
    subject: teacher.assistance.observed
    contract: versioned envelope plus one learning-action assistance summary with observations
    ownership: teacher supplies assistance facts only; student remains the sole mastery authority
    correlation: learning_action_id identifies the exact student-owned action cycle
    mastery_join: student waits for the exact assistance summary, validates closure causation and frozen targets, then combines it with the private official outcome
  - service: ms-go-teacher-agent
    direction: produced by ms-go-student
    transport: JetStream
    stream: TASKANSWER_EVENTS
    subject: learning_action.closed
    contract: versioned trigger with action/context identity and frozen ordered targets only
    ownership: student owns action lifecycle and objective outcome; neither is transferred to teacher-agent
  - service: ms-go-teacher-agent
    direction: consumed by ms-go-teacher-agent
    transport: HTTP
    auth: general endpoints use the shared X-Internal-Token; learning_workspace and onboarding commands require the distinct TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN
    action_context: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-actions/{learningActionID}/context returns a safe frozen action projection and hides missing versus foreign ownership
    action_code_context: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-actions/{learningActionID}/code-context returns a bounded secret-safe text snapshot plus latest mutation-invalidated validation observation for the exact open action
    mastery: POST /internal/students/{studentID}/mastery/query returns ordered current mastery only for exact supplied targets
    learner_overview: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learner-overview returns v2 optional onboarding, bounded current mastery/path/diagnostic, and five recent session summaries
    assigned_lesson_context: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context uses existing shared X-Internal-Token read credential; exact owned frozen student-assigned-lesson-context.v1 with canonical identities, Go JSON three-string SHA-256 digest, title1000runes/excerpt4000runes/description1MiB UTF-8 and final response2MiB; no tasks/answers/translations or mutable Course fallback
    learning_workspace: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-workspace requires dedicated TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN (the general token is rejected) and returns student-learning-workspace.v1 only when STUDENT_LEARNING_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED=true; it is one repeatable-read, read-only selected-ACTIVE path/context projection for a generic Teacher workspace CTA, never a lesson-open or progress command
    diagnostics: POST /internal/students/{studentID}/diagnostics/snapshots freezes current mastery for exact requested targets
    learning_session: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-sessions/{sessionID} returns the exact ownership-scoped session
    session_metrics: PUT /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-sessions/{sessionID}/metrics accepts trusted bounded active-learning aggregates and extended activity counts
    analytics_correlation: Student session start may store an optional opaque Statistic analytics_session_id; it is not a second session owner
    excludes: objective action outcome, answer and Sandbox identity, raw validator output, raw evidence, reducer audit, dialog history, unrestricted history, and learning-workspace planner/rationale/content identifiers
  - service: ms-go-teacher-agent
    direction: consumed by ms-go-student
    transport: HTTP
    auth: dedicated TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN
    onboarding_turn_v2:
      apply: POST /internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns accepts student-onboarding-turn.v2
      lookup: GET /internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns/{studentCommandID} returns student-onboarding-turn-result.v2
      prove_no_effect: POST /internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns/{studentCommandID}/prove-no-effect accepts student-onboarding-turn-no-effect-proof.v2
      identity: Student injects studentID and validates canonical IDs, bounded slots, causal evidence, and expected versions; Teacher never sends a raw model or profile-shaped write
      ownership: Student owns draft/profile transition, immutable command receipt, and accepted-value provenance; Teacher is the only caller and no browser route exists
      rollout: TEACHER_ONBOARDING_TURN_V2_ENABLED defaults false; exact replay/recovery remains available while new effects are disabled
  - service: ms-go-course
    transport: HTTP
    auth: X-Internal-Token plus public visibility preflight or exact Student-owned non-archived Course assignment
    owns: Course hierarchy, task metadata, ordered opaque task learning-target references, assessment answer keys, completion data, positions
    task_learning_targets: additive type/key/optional-version metadata; legacy tasks may return none; student does not infer missing targets
    student_projection: recursively removes expected_answers and structured assessment answer keys from trusted metadata
    diagnostic_catalog: Student validates plan reservation against GET /internal/course/get-internal-diagnostic-assessments/{courseID} using the distinct COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_TOKEN mapped to Course DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN; redirects, stale catalog refs, and invalid wire fail closed
  - service: ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator
    transport: HTTP
    auth: X-Internal-Token
    owns: v2 catalog, frozen task instances, sandbox linkage, progress, checkpoints, submissions, assistance, validation/review aggregation, and task results
    direction_v2: Practice posts passed competency evidence to Student; Student does not orchestrate v2 Practice runtime
    action_binding_endpoint: PUT|GET /internal/v2/students/{studentID}/practice-learning-actions/{taskInstanceID} plus strict /open, /cancel, and /evidence commands, protected by dedicated PRACTICE_TASK_INTERNAL_TOKEN
    action_binding_ownership: Student allocates only the learning-action binding; Practice retains instance execution, evaluations, submissions, and results. Binding requests exclude private evaluation/fixture/solution data.
    evidence_endpoint: legacy POST /internal/students/{studentID}/practice-evidence remains v1; verified binding closure is POST /internal/v2/students/{studentID}/practice-learning-actions/{taskInstanceID}/evidence
    evidence_contract: v1 remains compatible; verified v2 requires the Student-issued learning_action_id, exact immutable revision/digests and ordered versioned targets, with canonical evidence/submission UUID idempotency
    evidence_commit: immutable receipt and target rows, shared student-mastery-v1 projection, and separate audit commit atomically
    compatibility_v1: Student may read old catalog runtime/evaluation contexts only for retained legacy rows; legacy writers are disabled by default
    private_evaluation: never accepted in the evidence contract and never exposed through Student projections
  - service: ms-go-sandbox
    transport: HTTP plus retained Core NATS archive RPC
    auth: X-Internal-Token for internal HTTP
    owns: workspaces, snapshots, sandbox sessions, live validation, archive/upload operation
    practice_workspace: one stable workspace task id is reused across milestone and mentor-change answer ids
    teacher_code_context: Student resolves the exact private answer binding, sanitizes and bounds the snapshot, joins sandbox-validation-observation-v1, and never exposes Sandbox identity or raw validation
  - service: ms-go-ai-prompt
    transport: HTTP
    endpoint: POST /api/v1/prompts/execute
    auth: X-Internal-Token
    contract: practice_task.review.v1
    use: optional advisory final review over sanitized workspace files; provider/schema failures follow the variant fallback and never fail deterministic student validation
  - service: ms-go-validation-orchestrator
    transport: HTTP
    endpoint: POST /api/v1/validate
    mode: final
    auth: X-Internal-Token from VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN
    owns: stage-based final validation result
    practice_task_final_gate: every selected milestone contract is rerun in final mode against the current sandbox snapshot before a project review is created
  - service: engine validators
    transport: HTTP and legacy NATS
    use: legacy non-V1 validation fallback
    html_response: HTTP and NATS require present non-null boolean isValid and errors array; positive cannot contain issues; malformed issues or technical envelopes and non-200 HTTP are generic technical errors without learner result or provider body
    html_issue: code must be nonempty string; message must be present string, with authored empty or whitespace messages preserved as semantic feedback
    html_compatibility: semantic negative including false with empty errors remains negative; existing HTML file selection and error path mapping retained
    css: every .css/.scss/.acss file via configured CSS_VALIDATOR_SUBJECT, language/code/rules.rules empty/locale en/meta taskId and path; existing local code_structure criteria run first
    css_response: required non-null boolean isValid and errors array; true requires no errors, false requires structured errors; malformed protocol and internal.compiler_error are generic technical errors
    css_feedback: only eight semantic I18nMessageKey rule codes are accepted; arbitrary provider messages are replaced with static safe feedback, unknown codes are technical protocol errors; file and position remain correlated to the submitted workspace file
    css_source: missing stylesheet is NO_CSS_FILE; empty existing source reaches provider; .sass is unsupported technical error before requests
  - service: ms-go-filestorage
    transport: indirect through sandbox archive/upload plus direct HTTP for portfolio snapshot storage
    endpoints: ['GET /api/v1/files/{id}/download', 'POST /api/v1/files/upload', 'POST /api/v1/files/{id}/activate']
    owned_reference: student_task_answer.filestorage_id, practice artifacts, and internal portfolio snapshot references
    publication_source: download the ordinary immutable artifact referenced by the passed mentor review
    mentor_review_source: authorized reviewer detail downloads the immutable artifact referenced by the pending review, applies the same safe text/path/secret boundary, and never returns the storage ID
    publication_snapshot: sanitize and deterministically repackage source, encrypt with AES-256-GCM in ms-go-student, upload as a 60-minute temporary opaque blob, persist pending row, activate blob, then mark ready
    security_boundary: current FileStorage endpoints do not provide a trusted authorization boundary; stored portfolio bytes must remain ciphertext and the storage ID must never be public
    configuration: PRACTICE_TASK_PUBLICATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY must decode to exactly 32 bytes; an empty key disables publication operations without preventing service startup
timeouts:
  course: 10s or 15s by client
  practice_catalog: 15s
  ai_prompt: 90s
  sandbox: 20s or 30s by client
  validation_orchestrator: 60s in legacy final-validation client; 30s in runtime client
known_limits:
  - onboarding draft question wording/options and progressive presentation remain frontend/Teacher concerns; Student stores only the eventual bounded profile fields
  - response bodies are generally decoded or read without explicit size limits
  - service URLs are configuration trust boundaries
  - USER_SERVICE_BASE_URL is currently unused
  - publication pending rows whose temporary file expires require operator reconciliation; retry is idempotent only while the stored file remains activatable
  - CSS legacy fallback compiles/parses each stylesheet but receives no task rubric; provider internal.compiler_error conflates source syntax and environment failures, so Student cannot classify it as learner failure
  - sandbox archive uses NATS first and falls back to HTTP on any NATS error
  - targetless legacy or current actions publish a valid empty target snapshot; teacher-agent must deduplicate without inventing observations
  - mastery does not query a target graph; Learning Planner owns prerequisite closure and gap policy, while Student owns evidence, mastery, and current path state
  - task-scoped teacher context uses the frozen action target snapshot; general and lesson context use the bounded learner overview
  - task-scoped code context is transient and text-only; only mutation-invalidated pass/issue-count validation facts cross the boundary and raw live/final validator results remain outside
  - legacy practice-runtime snapshots without authored milestone learning targets remain targetless
sources:
  - cmd/ms-student-service/main.go
  - internal/adapters/courseclient
  - internal/adapters/catalogclient
  - internal/adapters/sandbox
  - internal/adapters/validators
  - internal/adapters/filestorage

next_action_practice_execution:
  owner: ms-go-practice-runtime
  direction: Student reads Runtime
  method: GET
  endpoint: /internal/v2/task-instances/{id}/execution-projection?student_id={studentID}
  auth: PRACTICE_RUNTIME_INTERNAL_TOKEN in X-Internal-Token
  schema: practice-execution-projection.v1
  config: PRACTICE_RUNTIME_URL and PRACTICE_RUNTIME_INTERNAL_TOKEN; absent/unavailable yields WAITING runtime_unavailable
  correlation: exact student, instance, learning action, revision, digest, path, item, requirement against Student-owned binding
  boundedness: 32 KiB JSON, eight actions, five-second timeout; no validator internals, workspace bindings, private artifacts, or capability
  semantics: READY/BLOCKED/COMPLETED/CANCELLED projection and supported actions; Runtime owns state machine
